P7-GAP-001.current_behavior: POS checkout dispatches thermal ESC-POS receipt printing command before receiving verified HTTP 200/201 commit from server.
P7-GAP-001.failure_scenario: If server rejects transaction due to network drop or validation error, customer receives printed paper receipt while transaction remains uncommitted in outbox.
P7-GAP-001.offline_impact: Allowed by design for offline outbox, but creates mismatch if outbox entry is subsequently corrupted or rejected.
P7-GAP-001.sync_impact: Outbox must replay and reconcile with server later.
P7-GAP-001.multi_device_impact: Paper receipt issued before server assigns immutable invoice ID.
P7-GAP-001.financial_impact: Customer holds valid proof of payment before backend confirms ledger deposit.
P7-GAP-001.inventory_impact: Physical stock leaves store before inventory ledger deduction is confirmed.
P7-GAP-001.historical_integrity_impact: Receipt invoice number is locally projected rather than server-certified.
P7-GAP-001.operator_impact: Cashier hands receipt to customer without knowing if cloud sync will succeed.

P7-GAP-002.current_behavior: Multiple offline POS terminals can sell the same cached inventory units without distributed lock or reservation.
P7-GAP-002.failure_scenario: Two disconnected counters sell 5 available units each (total 10 sold against 5 physical in stock). On sync, server blindly accepts both sales.
P7-GAP-002.offline_impact: Local devices have no inter-device locking mechanism.
P7-GAP-002.sync_impact: Server allows inventory balance to drop below zero (negative stock).
P7-GAP-002.multi_device_impact: Stock double-spend occurs across uncoordinated devices.
P7-GAP-002.financial_impact: Revenue collected for physical inventory that cannot be fulfilled.
P7-GAP-002.inventory_impact: Inventory ledger records negative stock on hand.
P7-GAP-002.historical_integrity_impact: Chronological inventory movement ledger shows deficit balance.
P7-GAP-002.operator_impact: Store manager must manually reconcile stock deficit.

P7-GAP-003.current_behavior: Customer balance synchronization in BulkSyncService recalculates balances from transaction deltas, but offline client displays stale balance until next delta pull.
P7-GAP-003.failure_scenario: Customer pays debt at main branch; offline mobile POS counter still shows old balance and prevents further credit or displays outdated debt.
P7-GAP-003.offline_impact: Offline terminal relies on stale snapshot.
P7-GAP-003.sync_impact: Replay applies delta correctly, but client display lags until network reconnect.
P7-GAP-003.multi_device_impact: Discrepancy in visible customer credit balance across concurrent lanes.
P7-GAP-003.financial_impact: Risk of granting excess credit or misinforming customer on outstanding balance.
P7-GAP-003.historical_integrity_impact: Ledger movements are correct, but UI projection is temporarily inconsistent.
P7-GAP-003.operator_impact: Cashier sees obsolete balance until background sync completes.

P7-GAP-004.current_behavior: Device pairing service accepts any IP and port from QR code without validating subnet boundaries, private IP ranges, or timeout limits.
P7-GAP-004.failure_scenario: Malicious or misconfigured QR payload with external IP could cause mobile client to leak pairing token or hang indefinitely.
P7-GAP-004.offline_impact: Pairing fails silently if target device is on a different subnet.
P7-GAP-004.multi_device_impact: Mobile device cannot pair with Desktop counter.
P7-GAP-004.operator_impact: Operator receives generic network error without clear troubleshooting instructions.

P7-GAP-005.current_behavior: Quick customer creation while offline does not maintain a persistent temp-to-server ID mapping graph before sale item attachment.
P7-GAP-005.failure_scenario: If customer is created offline and immediately referenced in an offline sale, the sale payload must carry customer UUID which server BulkSyncService must resolve.
P7-GAP-005.offline_impact: Offline sales default to walk-in customer if customer UUID is unmapped.
P7-GAP-005.sync_impact: Sale may link to wrong customer ID if remapping fails.
P7-GAP-005.multi_device_impact: Customer records created on different offline devices may collide or duplicate.
P7-GAP-005.financial_impact: Credit sale assigned to walk-in customer rather than new customer Khata ledger.
P7-GAP-005.historical_integrity_impact: Audit trail shows incorrect customer association.
P7-GAP-005.operator_impact: Operator must manually re-link sale to customer on Web dashboard.
